subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], we are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight is scheduled for August 15th at 9:00 AM. Please arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Airline Team
